thread:
elaine: Kick off PRD scope negotiation — need firm launch criteria for the compliance surface (crypto + audit logs + retention). Sales asks: BYOK, signed exports, per-customer retention. Goal: agree minimal GA scope.
irene: @elaine from security: must support HSM-backed signing for audit exports and an immutable retention chain. Also require configurable redaction for PII and LLM prompts.
sam: Engine note: per-request HSM signing will add latency. Can we do async/batched signing instead of blocking the write path?
mike: Platform: we can implement nearline signing (buffer + batch job). Question for product: acceptable lag for signed manifests — 1m, 5m, 1h?
ash: Solutions: customers want retention tiers exposed (30/90/365) and per-customer policies + on-demand full export for audits.
nora: Legal: exports need chain-of-custody metadata and tamper evidence. Also we must be able to produce SOC2/ISO artifacts (config snapshots, evidence of access controls).
irene: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Signed export available for arbitrary date ranges (with HSM-backed signature)
- Retention policy configurable per-customer via API and console
- Redaction rules configurable; default redact 'prompt' + PII fields
- Proof of integrity: signature + hash chain included in export
- Export includes RBAC audit trail (who requested/exported)
If that looks good I’ll add to the PRD.
sam: Edge cases to call out:
- Customer rotates keys frequently => need key versioning mapping on exports
- Partial in-memory caches (KV cache truncation) => ensure audit completeness from durable store, not RAM
- High-volume tenants => export job must stream and avoid OOMs
mike: Operational SLOs proposal:
- Export job launched for daily slice <= 5m
- Signed manifest available <= 15m after slice completion
- Retention enforcement: do not delete before configured window + 24h grace
ash: Example retention config (API payload):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "retention_days": 365,
  "hot_days": 7,
  "redact_fields": ["prompt","user_email"]
}
```
elaine: Roadmap split (minimal GA vs stretch):
- Minimal GA: per-customer retention API, batched signed exports, default redaction, SOC2 evidence bundle for audits
- Stretch: HSM per-call signing, per-record signed tokens, export UI + on-demand live streaming
irene: :thumbsup: I’ll draft an RFC with threat model and SOC2 evidence checklist. Target: RFC by EOD Wed.
sam: I’ll attach perf numbers and cost estimate to the RFC draft.
nora: Legal will prepare retention clause language for the TOS once RFC finalized.
compliance-bot: Reminder: privacy review required before GA. Creating task INC-2026.
elaine: Thanks — next sync Thurs 10am to finalize acceptance criteria. @irene @sam pls add bullets to RFC by Wed EOD.
